name: story-splitter
description: Splits an epic you paste into the chat into thin vertical user stories (as a / I want / so that), each with 2-5 Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, a rough size (S, M or L) computed in code from reported facts, and a dependency order whose first story can ship alone. Large stories are split once more automatically. It never invents actors, business rules, numbers or system names: anything the epic doesn't say becomes a visible placeholder or an open question, and capabilities no story covers are listed. Honours 'Out of scope:' lines and 'max N stories'. Follow-ups: split story 3, merge 4 and 5, drop 6, which can ship first, as json. Read only: it creates no tickets and gives no day or point estimates.

skills.name: Split an epic into user stories
skills.description: Ordered, thin vertical user stories from a pasted epic, with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, S/M/L sizes computed in code, dependencies, uncovered capabilities and open questions.
examples: Split this epic into stories: <paste the epic>
